مِهْدَاجٌ A she-camel that yearns, or that utters the cry produced by yearning towards her young one: (K:) or that yearns towards her young one: (S, L:) as also ↓ هَدُوجٌ . (TA.) ―
-b2- Also, (assumed tropical:) A wind that has a sound; لَهَا حَنِينٌ: (S, L:) from حَنَّتِ النَّاقَةُ. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
